name: graph_observe_roundtrip
description: AG-3b's one path through the GUI: attach a graph to a scene object from the Inspector, edit a value on the canvas, watch what the running engine's published generation made of it, let the edit reach disk, and open the project again to find the same graph and the same number.

SAVE -- the commit of the edit is the save: open the untouched copy first

RELOAD -- come back to the edited project, which the engine re-reads from disk
